value.rationale: Establishes an exact, motivated infinite-horizon instability phase: a bounded alternating symplectic timetable loses all mean-square stability under every nonzero positive rate of mode repetition, yet becomes bounded again under permanent freezing. This identifies a genuine correlation-sensitive design boundary rather than a routine finite experiment or new notation.
